summary: Mediatonic and Devolver Digital's theatrical side-scrolling brawler.

entries.title: Foul Play

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively; Xbox 360 or Vita emulation is unnecessary unless preserving those platforms specifically.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at native display settings

primary.why: Foul Play released first on Windows and Xbox 360, then OS X, Linux, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation Vita. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the original PC brawler.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively; use local co-op where available for the intended brawler experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later remaster is documented in the cited public source.
